local LAYOUT = "same"
local ONLY = nil
-- P6d: which stacked objects a finger's touch reaches (IN14), with every event a renderer emulates. A top object T over
-- a bottom object F, in one layout (LAYOUT: "same" ScreenGui, a "lower" ScreenGui for F, or "nested": T a child of F),
-- for each T kind and both F kinds (a Frame, a TextButton). Down on the overlap, move within it, onto F alone, back
-- onto the overlap, up.
local kinds = {
	{ "button", "TextButton", true },
	{ "button-inactive", "TextButton", false },
	{ "frame-active", "Frame", true },
	{ "frame", "Frame", false },
	{ "image-active", "ImageLabel", true },
	{ "label-active", "TextLabel", true },
	{ "imagebutton", "ImageButton", true },
	{ "imagebutton-inactive", "ImageButton", false },
	{ "textbox-active", "TextBox", true },
	{ "textbox-default", "TextBox", nil },
	{ "scroll-active", "ScrollingFrame", true },
	{ "scroll", "ScrollingFrame", false },
	{ "group-active", "CanvasGroup", true },
	{ "frame-active-noninteractable", "Frame", true, "noninteractable" },
	{ "frame-active-transparent", "Frame", true, "transparent" },
}
local bottoms = { { "F", "Frame" }, { "B", "TextButton" } }
local function sendAt(id, state, x, y)
	touchAt(id, state, x, y)
end
local finger = 1
local only = ONLY
for _, bottom in bottoms do
	for _, kind in kinds do
		local name, class, active, extra = kind[1], kind[2], kind[3], kind[4]
		if only and not only[name] then
			continue
		end
		local guis = {}
		local function gui(order)
			local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			g.Name = "Stack" .. order
			g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
			g.ResetOnSpawn = false
			g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
			g.Parent = PlayerGui
			table.insert(guis, g)
			return g
		end
		local bottomGui = gui(1)
		local topGui = LAYOUT == "lower" and gui(2) or bottomGui
		local F = Instance.new(bottom[2])
		F.Name = bottom[1]
		F.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)
		F.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 200)
		if F:IsA("TextButton") then
			F.AutoButtonColor = false
		end
		F.Parent = bottomGui
		local T = Instance.new(class)
		T.Name = "T"
		if active ~= nil then
			T.Active = active
		end
		if LAYOUT == "nested" then
			T.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 50)
		else
			T.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150)
		end
		T.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)
		if class == "TextBox" then
			T.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		elseif class == "ScrollingFrame" then
			T.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
		elseif class == "TextButton" or class == "ImageButton" then
			T.AutoButtonColor = false
		end
		if extra == "noninteractable" then
			T.Interactable = false
		elseif extra == "transparent" then
			T.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		T.Parent = LAYOUT == "nested" and F or topGui
		local conns = {}
		for _, o in { F, T } do
			for _, ev in { "InputBegan", "InputChanged", "InputEnded" } do
				table.insert(conns, o[ev]:Connect(function(io)
					log("  " .. o.Name .. "." .. ev, io.UserInputState.Name)
				end))
			end
			for _, ev in { "MouseEnter", "MouseLeave", "MouseMoved" } do
				table.insert(conns, o[ev]:Connect(function(x, y)
					log("  " .. o.Name .. "." .. ev, x, y)
				end))
			end
			if o:IsA("GuiButton") then
				for _, ev in { "MouseButton1Down", "MouseButton1Up" } do
					table.insert(conns, o[ev]:Connect(function(x, y)
						log("  " .. o.Name .. "." .. ev, x, y)
					end))
				end
				table.insert(conns, o.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					log("  " .. o.Name .. ".MouseButton1Click")
				end))
				table.insert(conns, o.Activated:Connect(function(io, n)
					log("  " .. o.Name .. ".Activated", io.UserInputType.Name, n > 0 and "n" or "0")
				end))
			end
			table.insert(conns, o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(function()
				log("  " .. o.Name .. ".GuiState", o.GuiState.Name)
			end))
		end
		for _, ev in { "InputBegan", "InputChanged", "InputEnded" } do
			table.insert(conns, UIS[ev]:Connect(function(io, p)
				log("  UIS." .. ev, io.UserInputState.Name, p)
			end))
		end
		frames(2)
		log("== " .. LAYOUT .. " " .. name .. " over " .. bottom[1])
		log("down on both")
		sendAt(finger, 0, 200, 200)
		log("move within both")
		sendAt(finger, 1, 205, 205)
		log("move onto " .. bottom[1] .. " only")
		sendAt(finger, 1, 350, 200)
		log("back onto both")
		sendAt(finger, 1, 200, 200)
		log("up on both")
		sendAt(finger, 2, 200, 200)
		finger = finger % 9 + 1
		for _, c in conns do
			c:Disconnect()
		end
		for _, g in guis do
			g:Destroy()
		end
		frames(2)
	end
end
return finish()

stack3.body:
-- P6d: a finger over stacked objects in several ScreenGuis (IN14): stale hover in a lower gui, three guis, two Active
-- objects in one gui, a label above the Active object, an Active ancestor, Active toggled during a touch, a ScreenGui
-- with a higher DisplayOrder made first.
local function sendAt(id, state, x, y)
	touchAt(id, state, x, y)
end
local guis = {}
local conns = {}
local function gui(name, order)
	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	g.Name = name
	g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	g.ResetOnSpawn = false
	g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	g.DisplayOrder = order or 0
	g.Parent = PlayerGui
	table.insert(guis, g)
	return g
end
local function obj(class, name, parent, x, y, w, h, active)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	o.Name = name
	o.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	if active ~= nil then
		o.Active = active
	end
	if o:IsA("GuiButton") then
		o.AutoButtonColor = false
	end
	o.Parent = parent
	for _, ev in { "InputBegan", "InputChanged", "InputEnded" } do
		table.insert(conns, o[ev]:Connect(function(io)
			log("  " .. o.Name .. "." .. ev, io.UserInputState.Name)
		end))
	end
	for _, ev in { "MouseEnter", "MouseLeave" } do
		table.insert(conns, o[ev]:Connect(function(x, y)
			log("  " .. o.Name .. "." .. ev, x, y)
		end))
	end
	if o:IsA("GuiButton") then
		for _, ev in { "MouseButton1Down", "MouseButton1Up" } do
			table.insert(conns, o[ev]:Connect(function()
				log("  " .. o.Name .. "." .. ev)
			end))
		end
		table.insert(conns, o.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			log("  " .. o.Name .. ".MouseButton1Click")
		end))
		table.insert(conns, o.Activated:Connect(function()
			log("  " .. o.Name .. ".Activated")
		end))
	end
	return o
end
local function begin(title)
	for _, ev in { "InputBegan", "InputEnded" } do
		table.insert(conns, UIS[ev]:Connect(function(io, p)
			log("  UIS." .. ev, io.UserInputState.Name, p)
		end))
	end
	frames(2)
	log("== " .. title)
end
local function done()
	for _, c in conns do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	conns = {}
	for _, g in guis do
		g:Destroy()
	end
	guis = {}
	frames(2)
end
local finger = 1
local function step(text, state, x, y)
	log(text)
	sendAt(finger, state, x, y)
end
local function nextFinger()
	finger = finger % 9 + 1
end

-- stale: F in a lower gui, an Active frame T in an upper gui that overlaps F's corner
do
	local g1, g2 = gui("G1"), gui("G2")
	obj("Frame", "F", g1, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "T", g2, 350, 250, 150, 150, true)
	begin("stale: down F, both, T only, empty, T only, up")
	step("down on F only", 0, 200, 200)
	step("move onto both", 1, 375, 275)
	step("move onto T only", 1, 450, 350)
	step("move onto empty", 1, 600, 500)
	step("back onto T only", 1, 450, 350)
	step("up on T only", 2, 450, 350)
	nextFinger()
	done()
end
do
	local g1, g2 = gui("G1"), gui("G2")
	obj("Frame", "F", g1, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "T", g2, 350, 250, 150, 150, true)
	begin("stale2: down F, both, T only, up")
	step("down on F only", 0, 200, 200)
	step("move onto both", 1, 375, 275)
	step("move onto T only", 1, 450, 350)
	step("up on T only", 2, 450, 350)
	nextFinger()
	done()
end
do
	local g1, g2 = gui("G1"), gui("G2")
	obj("Frame", "F", g1, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "T", g2, 350, 250, 150, 150, true)
	begin("stale3: down both, F only, both, empty, up")
	step("down on both", 0, 375, 275)
	step("move onto F only", 1, 200, 200)
	step("move onto both", 1, 375, 275)
	step("move onto empty", 1, 600, 500)
	step("up on empty", 2, 600, 500)
	nextFinger()
	done()
end
do
	local g1, g2 = gui("G1"), gui("G2")
	obj("TextButton", "B", g1, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "T", g2, 350, 250, 150, 150, true)
	begin("stale4 (B a button): down B, both, up on both")
	step("down on B only", 0, 200, 200)
	step("move onto both", 1, 375, 275)
	step("up on both", 2, 375, 275)
	nextFinger()
	done()
end
-- three guis
do
	local g1, g2, g3 = gui("G1"), gui("G2"), gui("G3")
	obj("Frame", "F1", g1, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "A", g2, 150, 150, 200, 150, true)
	obj("Frame", "L", g3, 180, 180, 100, 100)
	begin("three: F1 < A (Active) < L, separate guis")
	step("down on all", 0, 200, 200)
	step("move within all", 1, 205, 205)
	step("move onto F1+A", 1, 320, 200)
	step("move onto F1 only", 1, 380, 120)
	step("back onto all", 1, 200, 200)
	step("up on all", 2, 200, 200)
	nextFinger()
	done()
end
-- two Active objects in one gui, a button on top
do
	local g = gui("G")
	obj("Frame", "F", g, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "A2", g, 150, 150, 200, 150, true)
	obj("TextButton", "A1", g, 180, 180, 100, 100, true)
	begin("twoactive: F < A2 (Active frame) < A1 (button), one gui")
	step("down on all", 0, 200, 200)
	step("move within all", 1, 205, 205)
	step("move onto F+A2", 1, 320, 200)
	step("move onto F only", 1, 380, 120)
	step("back onto all", 1, 200, 200)
	step("up on all", 2, 200, 200)
	nextFinger()
	done()
end
-- a plain label above the Active object
do
	local g = gui("G")
	obj("Frame", "F", g, 100, 100, 300, 200)
	obj("Frame", "T", g, 150, 150, 200, 150, true)
	obj("TextLabel", "L", g, 180, 180, 100, 100)
	begin("labelabove: F < T (Active) < L (label), one gui")
	step("down on all", 0, 200, 200)
	step("move within all", 1, 205, 205)
	step("move onto F+T", 1, 320, 200)
	step("back onto all", 1, 200, 200)

local ONLY = nil

	{ "frame-active-transparent", "Frame", true, "transparent" },

	mouseTo(x, y)

				table.insert(conns, o.Activated:Connect(function(io, n)
					log("  " .. o.Name .. ".Activated", io.UserInputType.Name, n > 0 and "n" or "0")
				end))

			table.insert(conns, o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("GuiState"):Connect(function()
				log("  " .. o.Name .. ".GuiState", o.GuiState.Name)
			end))
		end
		for _, ev in { "InputBegan", "InputChanged", "InputEnded" } do
			table.insert(conns, UIS[ev]:Connect(function(io, p)
				log("  UIS." .. ev, io.UserInputType.Name, io.UserInputState.Name, p)
			end))

		log("== " .. LAYOUT .. " " .. name .. " over " .. bottom[1])

-- P6e IN14b: the legacy Mouse's Button1/2 Down/Up (and UIS) for the mouse's three buttons over empty space, a plain
-- Frame, an Active Frame, a TextLabel, a TextBox and an inactive TextButton
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local KIND = { [0] = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, [1] = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2, [2] = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3 }
local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
g.Name = "Legacy"
g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
g.ResetOnSpawn = false
g.Parent = PlayerGui
local function obj(class, name, x, active)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	o.Name = name
	o.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 100)
	o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100)
	if active ~= nil then
		o.Active = active
	end
	if o:IsA("TextBox") then
		o.ClearTextOnFocus = false
	end
	o.Parent = g
	return o
end
obj("Frame", "Plain", 100, false)
obj("Frame", "ActiveFrame", 220, true)
obj("TextLabel", "Label", 340)
obj("TextBox", "Box", 460)
obj("TextButton", "InactiveButton", 580, false)
local conns = {}
for _, ev in { "Button1Down", "Button1Up", "Button2Down", "Button2Up" } do
	table.insert(conns, mouse[ev]:Connect(function()
		log("  Mouse." .. ev)
	end))
end
for _, ev in { "InputBegan", "InputEnded" } do
	table.insert(conns, UIS[ev]:Connect(function(io, p)
		if io.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			log("  UIS." .. ev, io.UserInputType.Name, p)
		end
	end))
end
for _, spot in { { "empty", 50, 400 }, { "Plain", 150, 150 }, { "ActiveFrame", 270, 150 }, { "Label", 390, 150 }, { "Box", 510, 150 }, { "InactiveButton", 630, 150 } } do
	mouseTo(spot[2], spot[3])
	for n = 0, 2 do
		log(spot[1] .. " MB" .. (n + 1))
		waitInput(UIS.InputBegan, KIND[n], function()
			VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(spot[2], spot[3], n, true, game, 0)
		end)
		waitInput(UIS.InputEnded, KIND[n], function()
			VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(spot[2], spot[3], n, false, game, 0)
		end)
	end
	local focused = UIS:GetFocusedTextBox()
	if focused then
		focused:ReleaseFocus()
		frames(2)
	end
end

	c:Disconnect()
end

frames(2)

	local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")

	g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	g.ResetOnSpawn = false
	g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	table.insert(made, g)
	return g

local function Button(name, parent, x, y)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Name = name
	b.Text = name
	b.AutoButtonColor = false
	b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
	b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 300)
	b.Parent = parent
	table.insert(conns, b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		log("  " .. name .. ".Click")
	end))
	table.insert(conns, b.Activated:Connect(function()
		log("  " .. name .. ".Activated")
	end))
	return b

	local names = {}
	for _, o in PlayerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(x, y) do
		table.insert(names, o.Name)
	end
	return table.concat(names, ",")
end

	log("click", x, y, "hits", hits(x, y))
	mouseTo(x, y)
	mouseButton(true, x, y)
	mouseButton(false, x, y)
	frames(2)
end
